sources.purpose: Attestation among the country's resident population, not a claim of national linguistic origin; no incidence estimates used as selection weights.
Pinned Latin-script national surname list, source ordering retained after documented de-duplication/exclusions. Redistribution rights not established; data are research-only.
Greek passport ELOT 743 / ISO 843 romanization reference; actual values are source-observed pre-romanized Latin surname forms, not newly invented transliterations or certified ELOT conversions.

sources.license: AGPL-3.0 dataset repository; government public election data. Reuse rights and Latin transcription accuracy need preproduction review.
sources.romanization: Recorded Greek surname field for individual election candidates, rendered mechanically in Latin according to ELOT 743 / ISO 843 mappings. Accents removed; θ=th, χ=ch, ου=ou, αι=ai, ει=ei, οι=oi, γγ=ng, diphthong αυ/ευ follows voiced/voiceless rule. Romanized forms derived by a standard, not independently verified as each person's official Latin spelling. Original surnames not synthesized.
sources.exclusions: Reject unsupported symbols, nicknames or parenthetical names; preserve complete authentic spaced or hyphenated surname strings.
